items.title: Onsemi and Czech ministry cancel $2 billion chip facility expansion
items.summary: Investing.com -- ON Semiconductor Corporation (NASDAQ:ON) has abandoned plans for a multi-year, $2 billion expansion in the Czech Republic, agreeing with local authorities to halt the silicon carbide project as industry conditions shift. The decision marks an abrupt reversal of a major commitment first unveiled in June 2024 to build an integrated manufacturing hub in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm.
